name: AppleEconomy
summary: One currency per player in leaderstats, spent and granted only by the server, saved with a DataStore when the place allows it.

needs.boot: A server script requires it once (AppleBoot does). Nothing else.

gives.api: spend(player, amount, reason) -> boolean; grant(player, amount, reason); get(player) -> number; START (the opening balance); getData/setData(player, key[, value]); Changed(player, amount, delta, reason)
gives.attribute: player attribute <Currency> mirrors the balance, for any UI

limits: Saving needs a published place with Studio API access; without it the game still plays and says nothing is saved.
